ns2:course.label: Advanced Photography
ns2:course.description: Concentrated use of photographic processes for creative expression with emphasis on professionalism and the production of a photographic portfolio. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in Photography, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in Photography, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $12 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
